correctness.rationale: The displayed K_{4,5} rotation system traces to seven 4-faces and two 6-faces. The local extension adds two vertices and four 4-faces while preserving old face lengths; Euler characteristic and Ringel's formula show minimal genus at every odd n >= 5.

evidence: Grannell–Knor (2010) reports finite enumerations for \(2\le m\le n\le7\); https://grannell.net/Papers/kmn.pdf
broader_coverage.reasoning: The theorem covers infinitely many odd n, while the inspected primary enumeration is restricted to part sizes at most seven. The proof's extension is specific to the four-vertex part.

originality.rationale: The primary full text inspected enumerates small complete bipartite graphs through part sizes seven but does not state this all-odd extension. The contribution is a uniform rotation-system construction, not a re-count of the known \(n=5\) or \(n=7\) cases.
residual_risks: The full text of the related 2019 handle-insertion paper was not inspected; it may contain a general local operation adaptable to this setting.
